item.subject: science
item.stem: In a school garden in Jaipur, Meena observes a sparrow eating grains scattered on the ground and also catching small insects. The science teacher asks: how is the sparrow correctly classified according to how it obtains its food?

options.A: producer, because it lives in the garden where plants grow
options.B: omnivore, because it eats both plant material (grains) and animals (insects)
options.C: herbivore, because grains form the largest part of its diet
options.D: carnivore, because it catches and kills insects
